ops.body:
cc-sync integration phase 1 is complete: cc-sync/integration @ ff9d8a430426. Seven stage branches were merged, then D3/D6/D9/D11 in catalog/consumer, then capture/resident/pickup/service wiring, then reconciliation. Merge 2 fixed two real cross-lane bugs: capture never filled the Home/TmpRoot/UID fields that replica meta requires, and pickup and service disagreed on checkout naming, so list missed Orca- and branch-named checkouts. Gates: build, vet, race -count=2 across all 15 packages, lint 0.
Phase 2a Run wf_ce100eb1-460 (pins: synckit ea6d2df, reposync delta 2edb0c6):
- Merge claudenative-fixes, scheduler-d13, cli-delta and native-acceptance (sessionrestore + synthetic fixtures + acceptance harness).
- Implement F23 (sdk prompts count as autonomous).
- Implement D7 + clarification: mixed checkpoints are never Ready and never evict the last complete one; default pickup uses the previous complete checkpoint; --allow-partial is explicit; required test included.
- D13 wiring: due-time code stamps, BusyRetry, config tiers, and the required code-only-edit fixture.
- Orca binding-key API, D2 sessionIdMap, and a capability-gated D1 appendSystemPrompt.
- D15 sparse surfacing and --apply-sparse.
- Swap every remaining fake seam for concrete types: artifact.Store/OpenReadOnly, RegisterArtifactConsumer, worktree.Stamp/Verify/Restore, sessionrestore, the helper RPC client, the delivery status client, the installer, and Serve.
- Then build the real binary and smoke-run it.
Phase 2b (a two-host simulated E2E over the acceptance matrix) follows, re-pinned to the final synckit and reposync merges.
